"''We're not leaving you behind.|[[Torra Doza]] of Ace Squadron communicates with shuttle two's pilot|}} '''Shuttle two''' was one of three [[Resistance shuttle]]s utilized by the [[Resistance]] to transport recruits off the [[planet]] [[Dantooine]] in an attempt to escape a [[First Order]] [[Blockade of Dantooine|blockade]] around [[35 ABY]].{{ResistanceDate|2|17}} A [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] of [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s dispatched by the ''[[Thunderer]]'' to destroy the [[shuttle]]s managed to strike shuttle two during the escape, damaging its [[hyperdrive]]. Despite [[Ace Squadron|Ace]] and [[Jade Squadron]]'s efforts to protect the shuttle while repairs were made, the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE pilot]] [[Jace Rucklin]] blasted one of the shuttle's [[engine]]s, sending it plummeting towards Dantooine's surface. {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Shuttle two appeared in "[[Rebuilding the Resistance]]," the seventeenth and penultimate episode of ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]]. The episode premiered on [[January 19]], [[2020]], on the [[Disney Channel]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes/rebuilding-the-resistance|text=Rebuilding the Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/rebuilding-the-resistance-episode-guide|text="Rebuilding the Resistance" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Resistance shuttles]]
